mode.title: Server Mode
mode.description: Mode to run the MCP server: stdio for local integration, http for web deployment

port.title: HTTP Port
port.description: Port number for HTTP mode (only used when mode is 'http')

enableCaching.title: Enable Result Caching
enableCaching.description: Cache search results to improve performance and reduce API calls

cacheExpiryMinutes.title: Cache Expiry (Minutes)
cacheExpiryMinutes.description: How long to cache results before expiring (only used when caching is enabled)

maxResultsDefault.title: Default Max Results
maxResultsDefault.description: Default number of search results to return if not specified

searchRateLimit.title: Search Rate Limit (per minute)
searchRateLimit.description: Maximum number of search requests allowed per minute

fetchRateLimit.title: Fetch Rate Limit (per minute)
fetchRateLimit.description: Maximum number of content fetch requests allowed per minute

enableLogging.title: Enable Detailed Logging
enableLogging.description: Enable detailed logging for debugging purposes

safeModeDefault.title: Safe Search Default
safeModeDefault.description: Enable safe search by default for all queries
